result.title: Efficient Fréchet Distributional Decoder Alignment for Latent Generative Models
result.summary: Fréchet Distributional (FD) objectives provide an effective distribution-level signal for post-training generative models. For latent generative models, however, existing FD-based post-training methods optimize only the latent generator while keeping the decoder frozen: the decoder is trained on reconstruction latents obtained from real images but deployed on generator-produced latents at generation time. When these latent distributions differ, this \textbf{decoder train-generation mismatch} means that the decoder is deployed on inputs drawn from a distribution it was not directly trained on. We introduce \textbf{Fréchet Distributional Decoder Alignment (FDDA)}, an efficient post-training method that freezes the latent generator and directly optimizes the decoder on generation-time latents using an FD objective. A single epoch of FDDA consistently improves gFID and gFDr$^6$ across diverse flow-based and autoregressive latent generative models. Across all 11 evaluated models, FDDA reduces gFDr$^6$ by 34.0-59.6\% from the original pretrained models and provides a further 10.2-57.2\% reduction after generator-side FD post-training. FDDA also reduces total wall-clock time by factors of $3.6\times$-$328.7\times$ relative to generator-side FD post-training across these models. These results show that generator-side post-training alone does not exhaust the benefits of FD optimization, and that further gains can be obtained by adapting the decoder at substantially lower cost.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 FDDA：冻结 latent 生成器，仅用 Fréchet 分布目标在「生成期 latent」上微调解码器，以消除解码器训练分布与推理输入分布不一致的问题，在 11 个 flow-based 与自回归 latent 生成模型上改善 gFID、gFDr⁶ 并大幅降低耗时。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「读取模块在训练 latent 上训练、却在推理期 latent 上部署」的分布错配诊断，与 LVR 中答案解码器是否对齐于推理期产生的 latent 状态、以及 latent 分布漂移问题可能相通，可供核查借鉴。
